digest.component_or_area: LLM verifier model selection and class resolution
propositions: Three independent code paths select the verifier model but each breaks off the default provider, causing non-default models to silently skip the downgrade to standard.
Code-review's verify step declares no model: key and carries temperature: 0, so it falls through to cfg.model (frontier) and the determinism setting never takes effect.
Provider-qualified model strings like 'anthropic:claude-opus-4-8' defeat the equality test against the bare default, leaving the verifier on frontier even when standard is configured.
The equality test 'cfg.model == DEFAULT_MODEL' must be replaced with resolution of a reserved 'standard' class name, centralizing the logic into a single resolve_model_string() function.

The code-review verify step and all three verifier paths (resolve_verifier_model, _verifier_cfg, completion._verifier_model_for_completion) must resolve to the configured standard class regardless of cfg.model's provider qualification.
